KTP Seasoned smokers know: when you blend belladonna leaves with mugwort, you don’t get a poison - you get a stimulant. The smoke <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_MUGWORT_BELLADONNA">clears the mind and sharpens reflexes</LSTag>.

KTP Gilded tools are no luxury for any serious alchemist. While wood is hard to clean, metal often binds to its contents, sometimes with disastrous consequences. A thin layer of gold solves both these problems.
